template._note: The same grid as H3 Ref2VA: 17k+5 frames at 24 fps, width and height multiples of 32. The model is trained on about 124-362 frames (5-15 s); longer shots are allowed, with a warning. No continuous-sequence chaining: a shot continues the one before it through its first keyframe (continuity).

recipe._note: No subject pictures: H3 FL2VA has no reference slots, so subjects are written in words from the series config's `design` and the location from its `description`. Optional keyframes: shot:<id>:first is the first frame, shot:<id>:last the last (MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo's first_frame / last_frame; the text encoder sees them as <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, in that order). A shot with neither renders text-to-video. Recorded dialogue (dub / dub_keep_foley) is the shot's slice of the series config's audio.track (or its own audio_file), uploaded to ComfyUI's input folder and anchored at frame 0 with MiniMaxH3AddGuide. clone takes no voice sample here: it renders with generate and says so.

policy_fallback.why: H3 FL2VA takes no voice sample (it anchors a recording, but has no voice-reference slot)

size_hints.keyframe: the render size (any size works: the first frame is stretched to the canvas, the last is cover-cropped)

binding._note: ComfyUI's MiniMax H3 image-to-video template (video_minimax_h3_i2v.json: a subgraph, flattened by h3jobs.ui_to_api). No loader node: every value is patched into a widget, so it renders without any custom node beyond H3SaveShot, which takes the place of CreateVideo/SaveVideo. The template has no LoRA loader: one is inserted after the UNETLoader for the turbo LoRA. patch_graph wires the keyframes (LoadImage straight into first_frame / last_frame; the template's 1 MP pre-scale is dropped, the node resizes to the canvas itself) and the dialogue anchor (LoadAudio -> MiniMaxH3AddGuide at frame 0); prune drops the rest.

models._note: The family each model param must be (targets/modelid.py): names first, then the file's header. FL2VA and Ref2VA share every tensor, so a file named neither is accepted as H3 with a note, and one named Ref2VA is refused. Tiers (docs/API.md): the turbo LoRA is an accelerator (without it the pass renders its `base`), the rest are required. A substitute LoRA keeps the wanted one's step count and is never the SLA LoRA (it needs the block-sparse attention node).

presets._note: Turbo LoRA per pass, as H3 Ref2VA: the final uses lightx2v's 8-step FL2V v1.0 with res_multistep (ComfyUI's H3 t2v template, lightning branch); the proxy the 4-step v0.1 with euler (the user's own 4-step H3 workflows). Not the SLA LoRA: it is co-distilled with block-sparse attention and needs that node. The series config's pass blocks override model, LoRA and steps only when this is the series target; otherwise only their size carries over. `base` (no turbo LoRA installed): no LoRA, 20 steps, res_multistep, no CFG: ComfyUI's H3 i2v / t2v templates' full branch (the subgraph's 'Int' 20 behind 'If/Else Switch (Steps)', KSamplerSelect res_multistep, BasicGuider), which is also this workflow's own BasicScheduler value.

downloads._note: Where to get each file this target names (docs/API.md 'Downloads'). A url is only given when a trustworthy record has it: a ComfyUI template's or saved workflow's properties.models entry, or ComfyUI-Manager's model list; `source` says which. Otherwise url is null and source says what to search for. Never a guessed URL.

minimax_h3_fl2v_lightx2v_turbo_4step_v0..source: no URL: no ComfyUI template, saved workflow or ComfyUI-Manager model list on this machine records this file. Search Hugging Face for its exact name (lightx2v's MiniMax H3 FL2V 4-step turbo LoRA v0.1, ComfyUI conversion).
